ckets, and lawn or groundcover seed orders ship in about 3 to 5 days after purchase, and once an order is marked as shipped, tracking can take up to 48 hours to appear. After it ships, delivery is usually 3 to 7 business days, and sometimes up to 10 depending on the carrier and location.
